Welcome! I’m really glad you’re here, because together, we’re about to step into a story that’s all about transformation, resilience, and the courage to seek your own truth.
Imagine growing up in the shadow of the Idaho mountains, where every day is shaped by family, survival, and a deep mistrust of the outside world. That’s the world Tara Westover brings to life in her remarkable memoir, Educated.
In this journey, knowledge isn’t just something you pick up at school—it’s a rebellious act, a lifeline, and sometimes, the only way forward. We’ll explore what it feels like when education is seen as dangerous, and how the longing for understanding can quietly grow, even in the most unlikely places.
As we follow Tara’s path from a child without any formal schooling to the halls of world-renowned universities, we’ll face the tension between family loyalty and personal discovery. Every step she takes, every lesson learned, brings both freedom and a sense of loss.
So, get ready to reflect with me on what it truly means to grow, to break away from the familiar, and to find the strength to define your own life—even when it comes at a cost. Together, we’ll uncover the complexities of memory, the power of education, and the bravery it takes to challenge everything you’ve ever known.
